title: EyeComponent
description: One anatomical structure of the eye, the equivalent of a Salesforce object definition plus its record. Every component has the same facets so agents and render modules always know where to look.

id.description: Stable path ID, e.g. eye.cornea.stroma. Patches and agents refer to components by this ID.

type.description: Component type. Must match a file in schema/types/ and a render module in src/render/modules/.

summary.description: One line for the manifest; what the structure is and why it matters at the slit lamp.

optics.description: Refractive index, scattering and absorption (per colour channel), transparency.

appearance.description: Colour, surface finish, procedural texture parameters.

microstructure.description: Fine detail that matters clinically: cells, fibres, nerves, vessels.

physiology.description: Behaviour over time: reflexes, blinking, tear dynamics.

source.description: Textbook chapter, paper or standard the values come from.

reviewed_by.description: Clinician who signed off, or null.

facet.description: Map of property name to a quantity, an enum-like string, a flag, or a procedural generator.

generator.description: Procedural pattern (fibres, vessels, nerves, crypts). The render module interprets the parameters.
